Sandbox_WDecay_timeBudgetMs_tooltip: Maximum milliseconds per frame for world generation. Lower = smoother FPS but slower generation. Higher = faster generation but possible lag spikes.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanInterval_tooltip: How often the mod scans for new chunks around the player. Lower = more responsive but higher CPU usage. In Multiplayer, this value is automatically doubled.
Sandbox_WDecay_scanRadius_tooltip: How many chunks away from the player are scanned for processing. Higher = more area covered but more chunks queued at once.
Sandbox_WDecay_priorityRadius_tooltip: Chunks within this distance from the player are processed first with high priority.
Sandbox_WDecay_debugMode_tooltip: Enables detailed logging to the console. Only useful for troubleshooting or mod development.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingEnabled_toolti: If enabled, decay percentages increase the older the world is. Newly explored chunks in long-running worlds look more decayed.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingPerYear_toolti: How much all decay percentages increase per in-game year of world age. 25 means +25%% relative increase per year, capped by the Maximum Multiplier.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMax_tooltip: Upper cap for the world-age decay multiplier. 4.0 means decay percentages can grow up to 4x their configured values.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingMode_tooltip: Amplify: configured percentages apply fully from day one and grow up to the cap. Progressive: decay starts near zero and gradually ramps up to the configured percentages over the configured number of days, then keeps growing up to the cap. Combine Progressive with Incremental Re-Decay so already explored areas fill in over time.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveDays_tooltip: Progressive mode only: in-game days until decay reaches 100%% of the configured sandbox percentages. 365 = one year.
Sandbox_WDecay_progressiveStartPercent_t: Progressive mode only: fraction of the configured percentages already present at world start. 0 = pristine world, 25 = the world starts with a quarter of the configured decay.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingCurve_tooltip: Shape of the multiplier growth over time. Linear: steady. Logarithmic: fast early, saturates later. Quadratic: slow early, aggressive in old worlds.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingFollowErosion_: If enabled, the multiplier follows the vanilla Erosion Speed (days until full erosion) instead of the per-year rate: it reaches the Maximum Multiplier when vanilla erosion reaches 100%%.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingNatureFactor_t: How strongly world-age scaling affects vegetation (trees, bushes, grass, vines, ground overlays). 100 = base speed, 150 = nature reclaims 50%% faster, 0 = no scaling for nature.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingUrbanFactor_to: How strongly world-age scaling affects structural decay (walls, fences, doors, windows, barricades). 100 = base speed, lower values make buildings decay slower than nature grows.
Sandbox_WDecay_timeScalingVehiclesFactor: How strongly world-age scaling affects vehicle deterioration when Severity Scaling is enabled. 100 = base speed.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, chunks processed long ago receive additional decay passes as the world ages, applying only the percentage gained since the last pass. Without this, decay is applied once per chunk forever.
Sandbox_WDecay_redecayThresholdDays_tool: Minimum in-game days between decay passes on the same chunk.
Sandbox_WDecay_severityScalingEnabled_to: If enabled, world age also increases decay intensity, not just probability: vehicle parts spawn in worse condition and are missing more often, and damaged fences are destroyed more often.
Sandbox_WDecay_seasonalBiasEnabled_toolt: If enabled, generated vegetation follows the season: grass density is reduced in winter, lusher in summer, and leaves increase in autumn. Vegetation objects also update their seasonal appearance.
Sandbox_WDecay_treePercentage_tooltip: How many trees with random foliage spawn on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_treePercentageOnRoad_tool: How many trees spawn on roads and pavement.
Sandbox_WDecay_jumboXLXXLPercentage_tool: Chance for generated trees to use Jumbo XL or Jumbo XXL sprites.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeRedmaplePercentage_to: Relative chance for Red Maple trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeDogwoodPercentage_too: Relative chance for Dogwood trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeRiverbirchPercentage_: Relative chance for River Birch trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanlindenPercent: Relative chance for American Linden trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeAmericanhollyPercenta: Relative chance for American Holly (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeCanadianhemlockPercen: Relative chance for Canadian Hemlock (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_treeVirginiapinePercentag: Relative chance for Virginia Pine (evergreen) trees to spawn compared to other species. 0 disables them.
Sandbox_WDecay_roadCrackOverlayPercentag: How many cracked overlays appear on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_dirtCrackOverlayPercentag: How many cracked overlays appear on natural ground tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinePercentage_tooltip: How much ivy and vines grow on exterior walls and fences.
Sandbox_WDecay_multiFloorVines_tooltip: If enabled, vines also grow on upper floor walls. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesExteriorOnly_tooltip: If enabled, vines only grow on exterior squares. Disable to allow vines inside buildings. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesOnWalls_tooltip: If enabled, vines grow on exterior walls. Disable to prevent vines on building walls.
Sandbox_WDecay_vinesOnFences_tooltip: If enabled, vines grow on fences and railings. Disable to prevent vines on fences.
Sandbox_WDecay_trashPercentage_tooltip: How much decorative trash (non-lootable) scatters on the ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_trashPercentageOnRoad_too: How much decorative trash appears on roads and streets.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayGrassPercent: How much grass and plants appear as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCrackPercent: How many cracked floor overlays appear inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayTrashPercent: How much decorative trash appears as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayGrassPercentag: How much grass and plants appear as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCrackPercentag: How many cracked overlays appear on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayTrashPercentag: How much decorative trash appears as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_barricadePercentage_toolt: How many windows and exterior doors receive barricades. Random 1-4 wooden planks or metal sheets.
Sandbox_WDecay_wallPercentage_tooltip: How many exterior wooden walls are replaced with burnt/damaged variants. Excludes doors and windows.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRarity_tooltip: How often abandoned, rusted vehicles with blood stains spawn on roads.
Sandbox_WDecay_grassPercentage_tooltip: How much vanilla grass spawns as a flat ground overlay (decal, no depth - see Objects below for grass that characters can walk behind).
Sandbox_WDecay_grassPercentageOnRoad_too: How much vanilla grass spawns as a flat ground overlay (decal, no depth) on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_customGrassPercentage_too: How much custom grass and ground debris (leaves, twigs, stones, logs) spawns.
Sandbox_WDecay_customGrassPercentageOnRo: How much custom grass and debris spawns on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_floorLeavesPercentage_too: How many dead leaves cover the ground on natural tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_floorLeavesPercentageOnRo: How many dead leaves cover the ground on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentage_to: How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_groundDebrisPercentageOnR: How many sticks, logs and stones scatter on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayCustomGrassP: How much custom grass and ground debris appear as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayCustomGrassPer: How much custom grass and ground debris appear as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayDebrisPercen: How much ground debris appears as flat floor decals inside buildings.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayDebrisPercenta: How much ground debris appears as flat floor decals on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorOverlayLeavesPercen: How many leaf decals appear on indoor floors.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofOverlayLeavesPercenta: How many leaf decals appear on rooftops.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofPercentage_tooltip: How many roofs on upper floors are destroyed, with 80%% chance of replacing with a destroyed variant.
Sandbox_WDecay_roofGrassPercentage_toolt: How much vanilla grass spawns on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentage_tooltip: How many custom bushes and hedges spawn on natural ground.
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentageOnRoad_to: How many bushes spawn on road tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_destroyedDoorsPercentage_: How many exterior doors are destroyed.
Sandbox_WDecay_fencePercentage_tooltip: Base chance for fences to be damaged. Used as fallback when Break Chance or Bend Chance is set to 0.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceBreakChance_tooltip: Override chance for single-tile breakable fences (wood, metal bars, short chainlink). Set to 0 to use the base Fence Percentage.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceBendChance_tooltip: Override chance for multi-tile bendable fences (tall chainlink, metal dividers, tall wood). Set to 0 to use the base Fence Percentage.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceDestroyWeight_toolti: When a breakable fence is damaged, the chance (weight) it gets fully destroyed vs partially damaged. Higher = more destruction.
Sandbox_WDecay_fenceBendSeverity_tooltip: How severely bent fences become. Random picks any stage equally. Light always stage 1, Medium stage 2, Heavy stage 3.
Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentage_to: How much grass spawns as a real object (has depth, characters can walk behind it) on natural ground. Separate from the Grass Overlay option above - both can spawn on the same tile.
Sandbox_WDecay_outdoorGrassPercentageOnR: How much grass spawns as a real object (has depth, characters can walk behind it) on road tiles. Separate from the Grass Overlay (Road) option above.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorGrassPercentage_too: How much grass and overgrowth spawns as a real object (has depth) inside buildings on floor tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_indoorBushesPercentage_to: How many bushes spawn inside buildings on floor tiles.
Sandbox_WDecay_bushesPercentageOnRoof_to: How many bushes spawn on roof tiles (Z > 1).
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Overlays_t: Cosmetic section divider. These options control flat decals on natural ground, roads, indoor floors, and roofs.
Sandbox_WDecay_Divider_Nature_Objects_to: Cosmetic section divider. These options place real vegetation objects with depth and occlusion; they are more expensive than overlays.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleDecayEnabled_toolt: Master switch. Disable to prevent any vehicle deterioration from this mod.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMin_tooltip: Minimum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleRustMax_tooltip: Maximum rust percentage (0-100) applied to vehicles.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMin_tooltip: Minimum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_vehicleBloodMax_tooltip: Maximum blood intensity (0-100) on vehicle exterior.
Sandbox_WDecay_generalCondition_tooltip: Base condition applied to ALL parts (100 = full condition). Individual settings apply on top.
Sandbox_WDecay_generalConditionChance_to: Chance per part that the general condition is applied.
Sandbox_WDecay_engineDamageChance_toolti: Chance that the engine is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_batteryDamageChance_toolt: Chance that the battery is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankDamageChance_toolt: Chance that the gas tank is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankMissingChance_tool: Chance the gas tank is missing.
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankConditionMin_toolt: Minimum gas tank condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gasTankConditionMax_toolt: Maximum gas tank condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_tireDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that a tire is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_windowDamageChance_toolti: Chance that a window is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_doorDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that a door is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_hoodDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the hood is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_trunkDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the trunk is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_headlightDamageChance_too: Chance that a headlight is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_taillightDamageChance_too: Chance that a taillight is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxDamageChance_tool: Chance that the glove box is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxMissingChance_too: Chance the glove box is missing.
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMin_tool: Minimum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_gloveBoxConditionMax_tool: Maximum glove box condition when damaged (0-100).
Sandbox_WDecay_radioDamageChance_tooltip: Chance that the radio is damaged.
Sandbox_WDecay_heaterDamageChance_toolti: Chance that the heater is damaged.
